entry.title: An Inside Look at the Relay Market Powering Token Resellers and Fraud
entry.summary:
A market exists for reselling LLM tokens at a discount, primarily in China, using pooled API keys obtained through various exploits, raising concerns about LLM application abuse.

Why it matters: The existence of this market increases the risk of abuse for publicly exposed LLM-driven applications, necessitating better API key capping mechanisms from LLM vendors.

entry.title: Supporting ambitious external research through the Anthropic Economic Futures Research Fund
entry.summary:
Anthropic has committed $200 million to the Economic Futures Research Fund to support external research on interventions preparing society for AI's economic impacts, prioritizing large-scale projects and pilots.

Why it matters: This initiative aims to build an evidence base for effective interventions in an AI-transformed economy, guiding workers, firms, and governments in adaptation.

Anthropic released Claude Opus 4.5, an AI model designed for coding, agents, and computer use, with improved efficiency and accessibility at a new price point of $5/$25 per million tokens.
